_comment: Reporting channels for data broker complaints. Community-maintained: if a URL has moved, run `python3 report_tool.py report-dead-url <channel_id>` to open a prefilled GitHub issue. Entries are best-effort as of early 2026.

channels.name: Federal Trade Commission (FTC)
channels.notes: The FTC doesn't resolve individual complaints but uses them to build enforcement cases; volume matters. Reference 'data broker' explicitly in the narrative.

channels.name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB)
channels.notes: Use when a broker's data feeds background checks, tenant screening, or credit decisions — that can bring the Fair Credit Reporting Act into play. CFPB complaints get individual responses from companies.

channels.name: California Privacy Protection Agency (CPPA)
channels.jurisdiction: California residents (brokers doing business in CA)
channels.notes: California's dedicated privacy regulator. Also administers the Delete Act data broker registry and the DROP one-stop deletion platform.

channels.name: California Data Broker Registry (Delete Act)
good_for: checking if a broker is registered
channels.notes: Brokers operating on Californians must register annually. Operating unregistered carries daily fines — reporting an unregistered broker is a high-leverage complaint.

channels.name: Vermont Data Broker Registry (Secretary of State)
channels.notes: The first US data broker registry (2018). Registration filings are public and useful evidence — they include the broker's own description of its opt-out process.

channels.name: Texas Data Broker Registry (Secretary of State)
channels.notes: Texas SB 2105 (2023) requires registration; the Texas AG has been notably active on data-privacy enforcement.

channels.name: California Attorney General
channels.notes: Shares CCPA enforcement with the CPPA.

channels.name: Washington Attorney General
good_for: My Health My Data Act issues

channels.name: Colorado Attorney General
channels.notes: Colorado Privacy Act includes a universal opt-out mechanism requirement.

channels.name: Your state's Attorney General (all states)
channels.notes: Directory of every state AG. Nearly all have an online consumer complaint form.

channels.name: Information Commissioner's Office (ICO)
channels.notes: Complain after the broker has had one month to respond to your request.

channels.name: Data Protection Commission (Ireland)
channels.notes: Lead authority for many US tech companies' EU operations.

channels.name: EU Data Protection Authorities directory
channels.notes: Every EU member state's authority, for Art. 77 complaints.
